dimensions.instructions: How strong is this candidate's hands-on proficiency with Node.js (Express.js/Nest.js) for building backend services?
How strong is this candidate's hands-on proficiency with React.js for building frontend applications?
How much hands-on experience does this candidate have with databases such as MongoDB, PostgreSQL, or MySQL?
How strong is this candidate's experience with front-end fundamentals: HTML, CSS, and JavaScript?
How strong is this candidate's experience with state management (Redux/Context API) and component-based architecture in frontend applications?
How much experience does this candidate have designing/implementing RESTful APIs and integrating third-party services?
How well does this candidate understand authentication/authorization mechanisms such as JWT and OAuth?
How familiar is this candidate with cloud platforms such as AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud?
How proficient is this candidate with version control systems such as Git, GitHub, or GitLab?
How much experience does this candidate have with CI/CD pipelines and DevOps practices?

mustHaves.instructions: Does this candidate have at least 5 years of professional full-stack development experience (both frontend and backend)?
